title: Walk through Morne Coubaril's sugar and cocoa estate
description: Walk through an 18th-century working estate to learn how sugar, cocoa and coconut shaped life around Soufriere. The verified 8.5-hour catamaran day explicitly includes a walk through the estate grounds, historic plantation interpretation, fresh cane juice and lunch.

title: Browse El Alto Market after riding Mi Teleferico
description: Ride Mi Teleferico up from La Paz, then spend time among the stalls and street life of El Alto Market with a local guide. The verified three-hour city experience gives the market 30 minutes and also visits La Paz's General Cemetery.

title: Tour the Kiambethu tea estate outside Nairobi
description: Follow tea from the field to the cup on a family-run Limuru estate, then walk through indigenous forest and sit down to a farm lunch.

title: Roast and taste coffee on a farm near Nairobi
description: Trace Kenyan coffee from cultivated plants through processing and roasting before finishing with a guided tasting on the estate.

title: Make pottery by hand in a Marrakech workshop
description: Shape and decorate a clay piece with guidance from a local creative workshop that teaches modelling, wheel work and ceramic painting.

title: Cook Cape Malay dishes in a Cape Town home
description: Join a Cape Town host at home to prepare family recipes with Cape Malay influence, then share the meal around the table.

title: Learn to evaluate Rwandan coffee in a specialty masterclass
description: Work through the aromas, flavours and preparation of locally grown beans in a focused class at a women-led Kigali coffee centre.

title: Make a silver jewellery piece in Kuta
description: Design and handcraft a small silver piece with a local silversmith, using workshop tools from shaping through the final polish.

title: Repair ceramics with kintsugi in Tokyo
description: Join broken ceramic pieces with a decorative gold finish while learning how kintsugi treats visible repair as part of an object's story.

title: Shop a Colombo market and cook Sri Lankan dishes
description: Choose produce and spices at a local market before turning them into curries and sambols in a hands-on home kitchen class.

title: Cook with the Mamas of Zanzibar
description: Shop for ingredients and prepare Swahili dishes with a women-led community cooking group in a Zanzibari home setting.

title: Join a singing-bowl sound bath near Patan's Golden Temple
place: Golden Temple Singing Bowls and Healing Center
description: Listen to a one-hour evening sound session made with locally crafted singing bowls and learn how their tones and vibrations are produced.

title: Explore Tallinn's underground Bastion Passages
place: Kiek in de Kök Fortification Museum
description: Descend beneath Tallinn's old defences into limestone passages once used to conceal soldiers, ammunition and later air-raid shelters.

title: Walk the archaeological hill forts of Kernavė
description: Walk between the grassy mounds of Lithuania's medieval capital and read the shape of its former settlements in the valley below.

title: Follow Van Gogh's working years through Nuenen village
description: Walk between the village buildings and landscapes Van Gogh knew while creating The Potato Eaters, with the local museum adding context to his Brabant years.

title: Explore the Jervis Bay night sky with an astronomer
description: Join an astronomy guide for telescope and binocular views beside Jervis Bay. What you see depends on cloud, moonlight and season. Confirm the meeting location and weather arrangements with the operator before travelling.

title: Ride a fat bike along Culburra Beach
description: Explore Culburra on a hired fat-tire bicycle, with beach and coastal-route suggestions supplied locally. Plan around low tide, follow permitted cycling routes and check the sand and surf conditions before setting out.

title: Explore Bundanon art and its historic artist estate
description: Visit the art museum beside the Shoalhaven River and explore the Boyd family connection to this landscape. Homestead and studio access runs on a separate schedule and at a second site; check dates and transport arrangements before combining both.

title: Tour Hoover Dam's powerplant and observation deck
description: Go below Hoover Dam on a guided powerplant visit, then use the visitor centre's observation deck for broad views of the dam, Colorado River and Lake Mead. Tour access can change, so confirm the included dam ticket and current security rules before setting out.

title: Trace immigrant stories at Ellis Island's immigration museum
place: Ellis Island National Museum of Immigration
description: Ride the authorised ferry to Ellis Island and follow the museum exhibits through the stories of people processed at the former immigration station. The linked product matches only when the Comprehensive Tour or another option explicitly including the Ellis Island Experience and Immigration Museum is selected; shorter afternoon or Liberty-only options may not allow an Ellis Island visit.

title: Step onto the glass-floored Columbia Icefield Skywalk
description: Follow the interpretive walkway to a glass-floored platform suspended above the Sunwapta Valley. Access starts at the Glacier Discovery Centre by shuttle and operating dates depend on mountain weather.

title: Look over Vancouver from the Vancouver Lookout
description: Ride up to the Vancouver Lookout observation deck for a high view across the downtown peninsula, harbour and surrounding mountains. The linked guided option includes Lookout admission as a 45-minute stop within a longer city tour.

title: Zipline above the jungle at Nohoch Che'en
description: Clip into a jungle zipline above rainforest and river scenery at Nohoch Che'en before the tour continues to its other Belize activities. The verified product is an eight-hour combo, so check fitness, weather and the full itinerary rather than expecting a standalone zipline ticket.

title: Take in Panama City's skyline from the Amador Causeway
description: Pause on the six-kilometre Amador Causeway for views of Panama City's skyline, the Pacific entrance to the canal and ships waiting offshore. The guided option gives the causeway about 50 minutes within a wider Panama City tour.

title: Tackle the Gully Obstacle Course at Harrison's Cave
description: Balance, climb and cross the supervised 14-element Gully Challenge Course at Harrison's Cave Eco-Adventure Park using the supplied harness, gloves and helmet. The verified half-day product also includes the cave tram and park attractions, and participation limits apply.

title: Swim in Jamaica's Blue Hole near Ocho Rios
description: Cool off in the spring-fed blue pools at Island Gully Falls, where local guides help visitors navigate the rocks, cascades and optional jumps. The verified guided option includes 90 minutes and admission at Blue Hole as part of a five-hour two-waterfall tour.

title: Relax on Luquillo Beach after El Yunque
description: Unwind on Luquillo's golden sand and swim when conditions allow, with El Yunque rising behind the coast. The verified guided option schedules two hours at the beach between a rainforest visit and an evening bioluminescent-bay stop.

title: Explore an Indigenous cave in Arikok National Park
description: Travel by open-air 4WD into Arikok National Park and step into one of its Indigenous caves on a guided safari through Aruba's rugged interior. The route is rough and cave access forms part of a longer Natural Pool tour, so check mobility needs and the day's conditions.

title: Stand before the seven ocean-facing moai of Ahu Akivi
description: Meet the seven restored moai of Ahu Akivi, the unusual ceremonial platform whose figures look toward the ocean. The verified product visits Ahu Akivi for 45 minutes on day one of a three-day package; Rapa Nui National Park admission is not included and must be obtained separately.

title: Walk the sacred trail above Guatavita Lagoon
description: Climb the guided stone trail to viewpoints over Guatavita Lagoon while learning its Muisca history and connection to the El Dorado story. The verified day tour allows a 40-to-90-minute walk; select an option that includes reserve admission or pay entry separately, and remain with the authorised group and guide.

title: Watch a train pass through Maeklong Railway Market
description: Stand beside the working rails as market awnings and produce trays fold back for the train, then reopen after it passes.

title: Cook a Moroccan meal in Marrakech
description: Prepare a Moroccan dish step by step with a dada at La Maison Arabe, then eat the meal made during the workshop.

title: Tour the Doge's Palace and cross the Bridge of Sighs
description: Walk through the ceremonial rooms of the Venetian Republic, then follow the enclosed Bridge of Sighs into the former prison complex.

title: Enter St Mark's Basilica with a guide
description: Step beneath the basilica's gold mosaics with a guide who can connect its Byzantine decoration to Venice's trading history.

title: Ride a traditional gondola along Venice's canals
description: See Venice at water level from a traditional gondola, moving at a slow pace through the Grand Canal and connected waterways.

title: See Renaissance masters inside the Uffizi Gallery
description: Move through rooms built for the Medici administration to see works by Botticelli, Leonardo and other artists of the Italian Renaissance.

title: Tour Windsor Castle's State Apartments and St George's Chapel
description: Enter the working royal castle to see its ceremonial State Apartments and the Gothic chapel where English monarchs are buried.

title: Cruise among the islands of Oslo Fjord
description: Leave the city-centre waterfront by boat and pass the wooded islands, coves and cabins of the inner Oslofjord.

title: Soak in the Secret Lagoon after the Golden Circle
description: Lower into the warm water of Gamla Laugin, a geothermal pool fed by nearby springs and a small geyser near Flúðir.

title: Climb to Bled Castle above the lake
description: Climb to Slovenia's oldest recorded castle for its small museum, fortified courtyards and a high view across Lake Bled.

title: Climb Nea Kameni's volcanic crater and swim by Palea Kameni
description: Land on the black lava island inside Santorini's caldera, walk to its active fumaroles, then swim from the boat near Palea Kameni's thermal water.

title: Walk Cascais's Atlantic waterfront on a Sintra coast trip
description: Pause in the former fishing town for its beaches, sea-facing promenade and Atlantic air after crossing the Sintra coast.

title: Enter Seville Cathedral beneath the Giralda
description: Enter the vast Gothic cathedral to see its chapels, choir and the tomb of Christopher Columbus beneath the Giralda bell tower.

title: Abseil and swim through Empress Canyon
description: Build confidence on practice abseils before a guided canyon journey involving scrambling, swimming and a waterfall descent. Go with a qualified operator and confirm swimming ability, age requirements, weather and park access; this is a technical activity, not an ordinary walking track.

title: Paddle the Shotover River white-water rapids
description: Join a guided rafting trip through the Shotover canyons, paddling rapids rather than riding a jet boat. Water confidence and the operator safety briefing are essential. Confirm river conditions, age and fitness requirements and the transfer arrangements from Queenstown.
